question: Who was popularly known as the Melody Queen in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lata Mangeshkar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lata Mangeshkar:-**

 
 
• Lata Mangeshkar was India's most popular and respected singer.
 
• **She was known as the "Nightingale of India" and the "Queen of Melody". **
 
• She sang over 50,000 songs in 14 languages, including Hindi, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi, Assamese, Oriya, and Nepali.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shubha Mudgal:-**

 
 
• She​ is a prominent** Indian classical singer** who has sung for Bollywood films,
 
 
 
• **Anuradha Paudwal:-**
 
 
• She​ is a** popular playback singer **who has sung for many Bollywood films, but she is not known as the Melody Queen.
